title: triage scope_summary.modules records '+' for new-file bullets
detail: triage.py:33 extracts module paths with schema.extract_path_token instead of extract_module_token, so a scope bullet carrying the '+ ' new-file marker is recorded as the literal '+' in decisions/<feature>.json scope_summary.modules (seen: decisions/measured-token-usage.json lists '+' where prusik/usage.py and tests/test_measured_token_usage.py belong). The v0.5.5 '+'-marker fix never reached triage's copy. Surfaced by the measured-token-usage plan-critic.

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest tests/test_one_modules_parser.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
